## Outcome

PR opened: https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/6656

**Root cause:** VESUM-backed paradigms use English case keys (`nominative`, `genitive`, …) but `_build_paradigm_items` only accepted Ukrainian labels (`називний`, `родовий`, …). That silently dropped ~2350 lemmas with valid inflection tables.

**Fix:** Added `_paradigm_slot_case_key()` to normalize both spellings before building paradigm MC items.

## Coverage (full manifest + VESUM regen)

| Mode | Before | After |
|------|--------|-------|
| **paradigm** | 798 | **1973** ✓ |
| synonym | 251 | 251 |
| antonym | 209 | 209 |
| paronym | 32 | 32 |
| homonym | 22 | 22 |

Paradigm by level after: A1 517 · A2 463 · B1 528 · B2 295 · C1 172

## Pair-mode residual

Pair YAML inventory vs emit was analyzed. Thin modes stay below ≥1000 because:
- **Synonym:** 551 approved pairs (1398 still awaiting verification); ~500-lemma ceiling with current approved set
- **Antonym/paronym/homonym:** Most YAML slug legs are outside the 6000-lexeme practice pool

Details: `batch_state/practice/thin-mode-residual.json` (local, gitignored)
